disclosure_visible: caption: 'בשיתוף @mebook.ai'; Instagram paid-partnership label: 0 (media info 15 Oct 2026)
format: hands-only book flip-through with voiceover and burned-in word-by-word subtitles

hook_0_3s.opening_image: A hand holding a glossy hardcover book with a colourful superhero-baby cover and balloons over a white feather decoration
hook_0_3s.spoken: 0.7-5.1 s machine transcript: 'טוב תקשיבו, אני מתרגשת ברמות מהחבילה שקיבלנו.' (voiceover over hands and book)
hook_0_3s.on_screen_text: Book cover text 'לואם גיבור-העל' (partly legible, name on cover); subtitle 'טוב תקשיבו,' at 1 s
hook_0_3s.reason_to_keep_watching: Interpretation: an excited first-person parcel opening line plus a bright, personalised cover that shows a named character.

how_value_is_shown: Voiceover says she made a book for her son in which he is a superhero 'with all his photos'; the viewer sees the cover with his name, the cartoon child on pages, and finally his photo on the last page. Choice of story and customisation is stated in speech.
demonstration: Hand flips through the printed book from cover to end page; no creation process shown.
proof: Printed book pages with a cartoon child; a round real baby photo on the end page with the name. The photo and the illustrated character are not shown side by side.
emotion: Excitement and pride; 'זו לא עוד מתנה, זה משהו שאני יכולה לשמור לו לכל החיים' (machine transcript).
personal_story: She made a book for her baby son as a superhero; keepsake framing.
selling_language: 'זו לא עוד מתנה'; 'אפשר לבחור כל סיפור, להתאים הכל'; caption: 'קוד קופון alma10'
captions_on_screen: burned-in subtitles of speech: short white bold words (one to three words at a time) at the bottom of the frame, changing every second
editing_rhythm: About 5 detected shots; one long locked-off flip-through of about 24 s, no jump cuts between 3.3 and 27 s, so the pace comes from page turns and subtitles; end page shown in the last 2.5 s.
ending_and_cta: Last 3 s show the end page with the baby photo and 'MeBook' logo while the voiceover says to order, with a coupon code. Caption: 'קוד קופון alma10'.
price_or_code: caption: 'קוד קופון alma10'; no price. Caption says 'ואיזה כייף שדאגתי לכם להנחה'.
convincing: Interpretation: a continuous page flip shows real pages, the child's name and a photo, so the product feels real; the first-person excitement and a coupon create a clear action.
weak_or_overproduced: Interpretation: voiceover (not the creator on camera) and the machine transcript shows a script-like finish; the photo and the illustration are not shown together, so the likeness claim is not proven; mentioning Ai in the caption is the creator's wording.
lumebook_lesson: Interpretation: a top-down, hands-only flip-through of the actual book with a cover showing the child's name and a final shot of a real photo is easy to film solo with a phone, and it is a direct competitor format (MeBook). LumeBook could add a photo beside the illustration for stronger proof.
solo_without_child: yes: only hands and the book are filmed; a child's photo appears only on the last page.
not_verified: Book title and price; whether the voice is the creator's own; the wording of a few machine-transcript words ('רוצי להזמין אחותי'); like count (hidden: 3 shown is unreliable); who the child is.
